name: Weldbot
one_liner: Collaborative welding robots that program themselves from a CAD file.
product: Collaborative welding robots that program themselves from a CAD file, delivered as robots-as-a-service: customers rent each robot monthly, with no upfront hardware price.
target_customers: Plant managers at job shops with 20 to 200 welders
pricing_today: Robots-as-a-service: $4,000 per robot-month including 120 arc-hours per robot per month, plus $15 per arc-hour above 120 per robot per month. Paid pilot: $15,000 for 1 robot for 8 weeks from commissioning.
traction: One pilot running: 1 robot for 8 weeks at $15,000, with the clock starting at commissioning. The customer provides floor space, a weld cell operator and 5 representative parts. Success means programming time per new part under 30 minutes and weld rework under 2%.
